WITH cov AS (
  SELECT pol.Policy_Identifier, pol.Policy_Number, pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier, pcd.Effective_Date
  FROM acme_insurance.main.policy AS pol
  JOIN acme_insurance.main.policy_coverage_detail AS pcd
    ON pcd.Policy_Identifier = pol.Policy_Identifier
  WHERE pol.Policy_Number = 31003000336
    AND pcd.Effective_Date >= DATE '2019-01-01'
    AND pcd.Effective_Date < DATE '2020-01-01'
),
prem AS (
  SELECT SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS written_premium
  FROM acme_insurance.main.policy_amount AS pa
  JOIN acme_insurance.main.premium AS pr
    ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
  JOIN cov
    ON cov.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pa.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
   AND cov.Effective_Date = pa.Effective_Date
),
clm AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cc.Claim_Identifier
  FROM acme_insurance.main.claim_coverage AS cc
  JOIN cov
    ON cov.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
   AND cov.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
),
loss AS (
  SELECT SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS incurred_losses, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.Claim_Identifier) AS claims
  FROM acme_insurance.main.claim_amount AS ca
  JOIN clm ON clm.Claim_Identifier = ca.Claim_Identifier
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM acme_insurance.main.loss_payment AS lp WHERE lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier)
     OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM acme_insurance.main.loss_reserve AS lr WHERE lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier)
)
SELECT 31003000336 AS policy_number,
       loss.claims,
       loss.incurred_losses,
       prem.written_premium,
       CAST(loss.incurred_losses AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(CAST(prem.written_premium AS DOUBLE), 0) AS loss_ratio
FROM prem
CROSS JOIN loss
LIMIT 501

WITH metric_1_written_premium AS (
  SELECT
    insurance_policies.Policy_Number AS policy_number,
    SUM(case when policy_amounts.Policy_Amount_Identifier in (from "main"."premium") then policy_amounts.Policy_Amount end) AS written_premium
  FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."policy_amount" AS policy_amounts
  LEFT JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."policy" AS insurance_policies ON policy_amounts.Policy_Identifier = insurance_policies.Policy_Identifier
  GROUP BY insurance_policies.Policy_Number
),
metric_2_incurred_losses AS (
  SELECT
    insurance_policies.Policy_Number AS policy_number,
    SUM(case when claim_amounts.Claim_Amount_Identifier in (from "main"."loss_payment") or claim_amounts.Claim_Amount_Identifier in (from "main"."loss_reserve") then claim_amounts.Claim_Amount end) AS incurred_losses
  FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."claim_amount" AS claim_amounts
  LEFT JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."claim_policy" AS claim_policies ON claim_amounts.Claim_Identifier = claim_policies.Claim_Identifier
  LEFT JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."policy" AS insurance_policies ON claim_policies.Policy_Identifier = insurance_policies.Policy_Identifier
  GROUP BY insurance_policies.Policy_Number
),
grain_keys AS (
  SELECT policy_number FROM metric_1_written_premium
  UNION
  SELECT policy_number FROM metric_2_incurred_losses
)
SELECT
  grain_keys.policy_number AS policy_number,
  metric_1_written_premium.written_premium AS written_premium,
  metric_2_incurred_losses.incurred_losses AS incurred_losses
FROM grain_keys
LEFT JOIN metric_1_written_premium ON grain_keys.policy_number = metric_1_written_premium.policy_number
LEFT JOIN metric_2_incurred_losses ON grain_keys.policy_number = metric_2_incurred_losses.policy_number
